Specifically, we formulate the quality of an image-caption as the binomial probability p = P (GOOD|image, caption) that can be estimated from the Bernoulli process in which every trial corresponds to a different rater. We then leverage Google's crowdsourcing platform on which we present (image, caption) pairs and ask volunteer raters the following coarse binary question, 'Is this a good caption for the image?'.
